transcript.content:
hey, I'm berry.

whenever you're ready, tell me your dream however it comes back to you.
hey berry. i keep thinking about the sky. it was that orange sunset colour, everything sharp like an anime or something

an anime sky, that orange that almost glows. it sounds like it stuck with you.

what about the sky keeps pulling you back?
it just felt too bright to be real, but in a good way? like the whole city was under it and it made everything look kind of fake but alive

too bright to be real but alive. i like that. it makes me think the whole place had a kind of glow to it.

so you were in a city. what was around you there?
i was on the roof of my apartment block. big city, lots of buildings. there was this girl up there with me that i didn't know

a stranger on the roof with you. that's interesting.

what was she doing?
she had an old red bicycle. short blue hair, yellow raincoat. she just pointed up and i looked

an old red bicycle on a rooftop. that's odd in a good way.

when she pointed up, what did you see?
this giant jellyfish. it was floating over the city, like pink and see-through, absolutely massive. its tentacles were hanging down between the buildings

god. that image. a huge pink thing just drifting above everything, its tentacles threading down into the streets.

did it feel scary, or was it kind of peaceful?
not scary. it was more like really quiet, peaceful. the tentacles weren't thrashing or anything, just hanging there

still and quiet, almost breathing. i can see why it stayed with you.

what did you do while you watched it?
the girl said get on. so i sat on the back of her bicycle

get on, and you just... did. like it was obvious.

where did she take you?
she rode straight off the edge of the roof. i thought we'd fall but we just went through the air, up towards the jellyfish

oh, so instead of falling, the city just dropped away below you.

what did it feel like, riding up like that?
it was smooth, like we were on a road but there was nothing under the wheels. i could see the whole city below, all the lights starting to come on

a road that isn't there, and the city lighting up beneath you. that's such a quiet kind of flight.

did you get close to the jellyfish?
yeah, we went right up into it. inside the pink light. and then i woke up

inside it. right at the end.

what was the pink light like in there?
soft, like being underwater but you could still breathe. it was warm and kind of glowing all around

warm and glowing, like the air got thick in a nice way.

and the girl with the blue hair... did she say anything while you were inside?
i don't remember if she said anything else. just the get on part stuck with me

that's fair. the get on is the part that mattered.

if you could pause the dream on one moment to keep forever, which moment would it be?
probably the second before we went into it, just the two of us on the bike, city below, that huge glowing thing right in front of us

that one second, everything suspended. that feels right to hold onto.

secretly important? like a detail that meant more than it said?
maybe the old red bicycle. it was so normal compared to everything else, i think that's why it felt important

so you were on the roof of your apartment block, the whole city under that orange sunset sky, too bright to be real but alive. there was a girl you didn't know, short blue hair, yellow raincoat, with an old red bicycle. she pointed up and you saw this massive pink see-through jellyfish floating over the buildings, tentacles just hanging down between them, quiet and peaceful. she said get on, so you sat on the back and she rode straight off the edge of the roof, but instead of falling you just went through the air, smooth like a road that wasn't there, the city lights coming on below. you went right up into the jellyfish, into that soft warm pink light, like being underwater but you could still breathe. then you woke up.

did i get it right, or did i miss anything?
yeah that's it exactly. you got it all

that makes me really glad.

would you like to see it drawn?
yeah i would actually

okay, before we get to it, let's choose the way it could look.

you could have a glowing anime cel, clean and precise like an animated film. or a watercolour memory, soft and blended like the edges fading. a neon dreamscape, luminous and surreal like a dream through a neon haze. or a photograph, realistic like a moment caught on film. which feels closest, or would you describe your own?
definitely the glowing anime cel, clean and precise. that matches how sharp and saturated it looked

okay, I'll start with the air above the city. I'm guessing it's a warm, glowing orange, clear and sharp, no clouds, just pure light filling the space between the rooftop and the jellyfish. these are my guesses.

anything different, or should I leave it to you?
no clouds feels right. the orange was really saturated, like the sky itself was glowing more than normal sunset

saturated, glowing orange, no clouds. got it.

were the buildings tall and close together, or more spread out?
tall and close together. proper big city feel, like everything was stacked against each other

I'm sketching the air above the city and the girl and the rooftop and inside the jellyfish and the old red bicycle now, and it'll appear on the right. only that, nothing else is being drawn yet.

you're in it too, so I'll draw you as well. would you like me to draw you as you are (you can tell me a little about yourself), or however I imagine you?
just however you imagine me. i don't mind
okay, I'll imagine you. I'm sketching you now too. everything is being sketched and will appear on the right over the next minute or two. if anything looks wrong once it's there, just say.
the sky looks right, and the jellyfish is how i pictured it. the girl's hair and raincoat are right too.

glad those parts came through.

does it all look the way you remember it?
mostly yeah. the city looks a bit more spread out than i remember, mine felt taller and tighter together

okay, I'll bring those buildings in closer and push them up taller, make it feel properly stacked like you remember.

anything else that feels off?
that last new one with the taller buildings feels a lot closer. no, nothing else off

that's good, I'm glad it's feeling closer to how you remember.

shall I keep drawing the rest of the dream?
yeah, keep going
the rooftop with the girl and the view over the city with the lights on are on the right. the other moments are still being drawn, they'll appear soon.
the rooftop one is right, and the lights starting to come on looks exactly like i remember

that's lovely to hear, rooftop and lights settled then.

do those feel right too?
yeah they do
good, those feel right. the rest of the moments are still being drawn, they'll show up on the right soon.
the one with us riding through the air is perfect, the city below is just how it felt

that's great, so the jellyfish and the ride through the air both look right to you.

since those look right, I'll keep drawing the rest, they'll be up on the right soon.
okay, i'll wait for the rest
sounds good, I'll let you know as they appear.
no rush, take your time
I appreciate that. I'm drawing the rest of the moments now, they'll be up on the right soon.
the one inside the jellyfish looks right too, that soft pink glow is exactly what i meant

that soft pink glow inside the jellyfish is exactly how you described it, lovely. just so you know, there's one more moment still to come after this.

the moment you said you'd pause on, you and the girl on the bike right before going in, the jellyfish huge right in front, the city below, is up on the right now. does that look how you saw it?
